paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 13b: he said in the name of Rav.[^1]

notes.text: Ila's heading title is abbreviated, retained as R'; Shmuel's full Rav remains. The body reports in Rav's name at Berakhot יג: (13b by convention), without a named-edition check. Marta receives no title.
